I, hereby give my consent for an intern at Dubai Autism Center to conduct assessments and consultations under the supervision of a licensed professional. I understand that the intern is a student who is completing their training in Psychology and is working under the supervision of a licensed professional.  

I understand that the purpose of the assessment or consultation is to provide me with information about my concerns and to give me appropriate treatment guidance. I understand that the intern will be working under close supervision and will consult with their supervisor throughout the process.  

I understand that I have the right to refuse to participate in any part of the assessment or consultation process and that I can withdraw my consent at any time. I also understand that my decision to participate or not participate in the assessment or consultation process will not affect my access to care or services at Dubai Autism Center.  

I understand that my personal information will be kept confidential and will only be shared with those who are directly involved in my care, as required by law, or with my explicit written consent.  

I have read and understand the above information and give my consent for an intern at Dubai Autism Center to conduct assessments or consultations under supervision.
